groups.summary: homeplane-server: tsnet enrolment with identity-preserving rotation, policy-bound per-harness grants, actor-modeled audit, strict healthz, admin CLI, and the age-encrypted secret store that is the only place provider credentials exist.
groups.title: Server control plane and custody

groups.summary: The connector-agnostic manifest (per-tool action class, capability, fail-closed unmapped tools, response-side artifact-id extraction), the streamable-HTTP edge with machine-bound tokens, the async OAuth credential broker behind add-credentials, and the guarded Google manifest.
groups.title: Connector plane: manifest engine, edge, credential broker

groups.summary: install.sh stages checksummed release artifacts, gates on the supported host set (macOS 13+, Linux with a working user systemd), and homeplane-agent handles enrol and live-reconciled status.
groups.title: Installer and agent CLI

groups.summary: Vault detection and Obsidian Sync retrieval with snapshot + destructive-diff guard, supervised GNO with a disposable per-machine index, and vault-authored skills discovered via profiles and linked natively into each harness.
groups.title: Vault, retrieval engine, and skills

groups.summary: Byte-span semantic-preserving merges into Claude Code and Codex config, per-harness grant tokens at 0600 with backups, and the agent side of the credential flow.
groups.title: Harness configuration writer

groups.summary: homeplane-server on the real Tailnet server under systemd --user with rootless podman, loopback-isolated gateway, and a verify script that checks 11 deploy invariants.
groups.title: Production deployment

groups.summary: The scripted live proof (14 stages, both harnesses against real Google through the server), operator docs from observed behavior, and the final gate that maps every requirement to passing recorded evidence and rejects unknown artifact identities. Also carries the Flow-Next tracking state (specs, tasks, receipts, bundled flowctl) that this pipeline-managed build accrues, included as mechanical rows.
groups.title: End-to-end proof, docs, and acceptance gate

groups.summary: Final acceptance gate 14/14 requirements at the gate head; 907 e2e assertions with 0 failures recorded in the live evidence file; go build/vet/test green across 21 packages; deploy verify 11/11 on the production server; completion review SHIP (codex/gpt-5.6-sol) after two rounds.

changeWalkthrough.thesis: One walking skeleton that makes any enrolled machine fully capable: credentials live only on the server, two harnesses reach Google and the local vault engine through separately revocable grants, and every action is audited with the real artifact it touched.
